title: Recovering from Averages: An Inverse Problem Perspective on Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 从平均值中恢复：机器学习原子间势的反问题视角
summary: 机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 根据量子力学参考数据近似计算原子系统的势能表面，并以接近从头算的精度实现分子模拟，且成本仅为一小部分。由于它们是根据总能量和力拟合的，因此估计的内容并不明显：总能量或多体势。从数学上讲，这可以表述为一个问题：函数是否可以从随机簇上的平均值中恢复。我们研究了简化统计设置中固定相关阶数的线性模型。我们证明，在人口限制下，潜力在自然加权索博列夫空间中是可识别的，并得出有限样本恢复保证。成对、三体和四体模型的数值实验支持了该理论。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26819v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approximate the potential energy surface of atomistic systems from quantum-mechanical reference data and enable molecular simulation at near-ab-initio accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Since they are fitted to total energies and forces, it is not obvious what is estimated: the total energy or the many-body potentials from which it is assembled. Mathematically, this can be formulated as a question whether a function can be recovered from averages of its values over random clusters. We study it for a linear model of fixed correlation order in simplified statistical setting. We show that, in the population limit, the potential is identifiable in a natural weighted Sobolev space, and derive finite-sample recovery guarantees. Numerical experiments for pair, three-body, and four-body models support the theory.

title: E2Former-V3: Atom-Role-Aware Equivariant Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: E2Former-V3：原子角色感知等变原子间势
summary: 机器学习的原子间势接近密度泛函精度，但显式溶剂原子计数以氢和水为主。统一的等变架构仍然为每个原子提供相同的潜在宽度和昂贵的块更新数量。据我们所知，现有方法还没有通过化学作用重新分配容量，同时保留每个原子及其第一原理力。我们引入了 E2Former-V3，它将容量视为原子级资源：在主干运行之前分配的静态化学角色，设置每个原子的潜在宽度和更新计数。没有原子被移除，没有坐标被积分，并且每个力仍然是一个保守能量的梯度。标准仅减少更新计数，通过一半的全角块更新发送氢；
abstract: arXiv:2611.27111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials approach density-functional accuracy, but explicit-solvent atom counts are dominated by hydrogens and water. Uniform equivariant architectures still give every atom the same latent width and number of expensive block updates. To our knowledge, no prior method reallocates capacity by chemical role while retaining every atom and its first-principles force. We introduce E2Former-V3, which treats capacity as an atom-level resource: a static chemical role, assigned before the backbone runs, sets each atom's latent width and update count. No atom is removed, no coordinate is integrated out, and every force remains the gradient of one conservative energy. Standard reduces only the update count, sending hydrogen through half as many full-width block updates; on OMol25 validation it reaches a force mean absolute error (MAE) of 8.146 meV/Angstrom, against E2Former-V2's published 8.38, at 1.75-1.84x V2's throughput with lower peak memory on one H200. Flash also narrows the low-resolution stream to one eighth of the high-resolution width (32 vs 256 channels) and routes water oxygen with hydrogen, reaching 4.00-4.88x on three solvated systems (up to 5.85x in the pure-water all-low-resolution limit) at 11.272 meV/Angstrom, trading force accuracy for speed. Across 54 20 ps MD legs, a 100 ps NVE check, and a 1 ns NVT run on a 32,437-atom solvated protein, all runs complete; the MD legs show no non-finite values, clashes, or water fusion, and water O-O and Na-O RDF peak positions match experiment within 0.04 Angstrom. E2Former-V3 therefore moves the accuracy-throughput frontier for all-atom, conservative simulation, not a uniform accuracy win: Standard is worse on biomolecules and metals, better on electrolytes and organics; energy MAE is higher than E2Former-V2's; and water densities remain about 7.5% too high. Code: https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM.

title: Prediction of lattice thermal conductivity of half-Heusler compounds by machine learning and transfer-function calibration
title_zh: 通过机器学习和传递函数校准预测半赫斯勒化合物的晶格热导率
summary: 对半赫斯勒热电材料的高通量搜索越来越依赖于第一性原理计算或基于其训练的机器学习模型的晶格热导率 (κ_L)。这些计算描述了理想的单晶，而测量是在多晶样品上进行的，其中晶界和缺陷也会散射热量。已注意到单个化合物的计算值和测量值之间的 κ_L 之间的差距，但据我们所知，未在材料类别中进行量化，因此用于筛选的值带有未知的系统偏差。在这里，我们量化并纠正了具有 18 个价电子的立方半赫斯勒化合物的这种偏差。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26788v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-throughput searches for half-Heusler thermoelectrics increasingly rely on lattice thermal conductivity (κ_L) from first-principles calculations, or from machine-learning models trained on them. These calculations describe an ideal single crystal, whereas measurements are made on polycrystalline samples, in which grain boundaries and defects scatter heat as well. The resulting gap between calculated and measured κ_L has been noted for individual compounds but not, to our knowledge, quantified across a materials class, so the values used for screening carry an unknown, systematic bias. Here we quantify and correct this bias for cubic half-Heusler compounds with 18 valence electrons. Using a curated literature corpus that keeps calculated and measured values apart, we show that calculations overestimate measured κ_L in most bonding families, and that the excess shrinks with temperature. Scattering by defects, added to the intrinsic scattering between lattice vibrations, would give such a trend, but the data do not single out one cause. A simple transfer function with this temperature dependence removes the median offset, and refitting its magnitude within a bonding family lowers the median error further, though not consistently compound by compound. Combined with a machine-learning model that predicts the calculated value from crystal structure, and tested on chemistries withheld from all fitting, the method predicts measured κ_L in this class about as closely as independent laboratories agree with one another, and provides testable predictions for compounds not yet measured.

title: Solving fermionic sign problems with physics-informed kernels
title_zh: 使用物理内核解决费米子符号问题
summary: 我们将具有物理信息内核（PIK）[1,2]的生成采样方法扩展到具有复杂分布和费米子系统中也遇到的结构的一般类物理系统。使用 PIK 方法解决复杂高斯分布的通用加权和的符号问题是该应用的核心。第一步，PIK 将真实正态分布映射到这样的加权和，这个过程称为 PIKfan。 PIKfan 具有真实正态分布的采样成本。第二步，使用第二个 PIK 将这个加权和演变成当前理论的分布。结合起来，我们将一类复杂系统的采样任务简化为高斯系统，主要的计算任务是计算 PIK。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27768v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We extend the generative sampling approach with physics-informed kernels (PIKs) [1,2] to a general class of physics systems with complex distributions and a structure also encountered in fermionic systems. The resolution of sign problems of generic weighted sums of complex Gaußian distributions with the PIK approach is central to this application. In a first step, PIKs map a real normal distribution to such a weighted sum, and this procedure is called the PIKfan. The PIKfan has the sampling cost of a real normal distribution. In a second step, this weighted sum is evolved with a second PIK into the distribution of the theory at hand. In combination, we reduce the sampling task for a general class of complex systems to a Gaußian one, and the main computational task is that of computing the PIK. We illustrate the approach with the one-site Hubbard model at arbitrary chemical potential and with φ⁴-deformed extensions of it.

title: Generating grain boundary structures at a specified energy with a symmetry-constrained diffusion model
title_zh: 使用对称约束扩散模型在指定能量下生成晶界结构
summary: 晶界（GB）控制着多晶材料的许多特性，逆向设计将使晶界结构本身成为一个设计变量。 MatterGen 等晶体生成模型在包含两个 GB 的周期性单元上运行。仅当两者等效时，电池能量才定义单个 GB，但现有模型并不强制执行这种等效性。在 MatterGen 的基础上，我们开发了一种对称约束扩散模型，其中两个 GB 通过对称操作相关：生成一个 GB 附近的原子，而另一个 GB 附近的原子则通过在每个去噪步骤中应用的对称投影来重建。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) govern many properties of polycrystalline materials, and inverse design would make the GB structure itself a design variable. Crystal generative models such as MatterGen operate on periodic cells, which contain two GBs. The cell energy defines a single GB only when the two are equivalent, but existing models do not enforce this equivalence. Building on MatterGen, we developed a symmetry-constrained diffusion model in which the two GBs are related by a symmetry operation: atoms near one GB are generated, and those near the other are reconstructed through a symmetry projection applied at every denoising step. We applied it to the Σ 5(210)[001] symmetric tilt GB in Al, conditioning generation on the GB energy from a machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). All 350 generated structures kept a geometrically equivalent GB pair after relaxation. Given a target GB energy, the model generated structures at that energy: for the three in-range targets with many nearby training structures, 44% to 70% fell within ± 0.1 J/m² of the target. Tracking weakened at higher energies and failed outside the training range. Of the 91 near-target structures, 90 matched no training structure under the adopted geometric criterion, indicating that the model can propose configurations near the target energy that are distinct from the training structures, a capability that could help identify unknown metastable GB structures observed in experiments. Building GB-pair equivalence into generation thus makes GB properties well-defined design targets, enabling inverse design of GB structures.

title: Reactivity-Informed Machine Learning for Performance Prediction and Design Space Exploration of Alkali-Activated Slag
title_zh: 用于碱活化渣性能预测和设计空间探索的反应性机器学习
summary: 建立配合比设计、原材料特性、固化条件和性能之间的定量关系仍然是水泥材料中长期存在的挑战，特别是对于具有可变前体和活化剂化学性质的碱活化材料。在这里，我们整理了迄今为止最大的文献衍生碱活化矿渣 (AAS) 数据集，其中包含 3100 多个抗压强度记录、155 个化学性质不同的磨碎粒状高炉矿渣 (GGBS) 以及 24 个包含前体化学、细度和反应性的属性。
abstract: arXiv:2606.06765v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Establishing quantitative relationships among mix design, raw material properties, curing conditions, and performance remains a long-standing challenge in cementitious materials, particularly for alkali-activated materials with variable precursor and activator chemistry. Here, we curated the largest literature-derived alkali-activated slag (AAS) dataset to date, comprising over 3100 compressive strength records, 155 chemically distinct ground granulated blast-furnace slags (GGBSs), and 24 attributes incorporating precursor chemistry, fineness, and reactivity. Multiple machine learning (ML) algorithms were benchmarked across progressively enriched feature scenarios, demonstrating that integrating GGBS compositions, fineness, curing conditions, and specimen geometry improves predictive performance. The average metal oxide dissociation energy (AMODE), a physically interpretable representation of precursor reactivity, provides a compact alternative descriptor to explicit oxide compositions while enabling comparable predictive performance. Model interpretation revealed physically consistent trends from heterogeneous data, including non-monotonic effects of Na2O dosage and silicate modulus, reduced predicted strength at higher water content and larger specimen size, and coupled oxide-level effects more coherently represented by AMODE than by individual oxide contents. Statistically constrained design space exploration reveals reactivity-dependent trade-offs among strength, embodied CO2 emissions, and cost. The design maps identify high-strength regions with substantially lower CO2 emissions than OPC-based references at similar cost. Overall, this work demonstrates how reactivity-informed ML can extract physically meaningful trends from heterogeneous AAS data and guide source-dependent binder design. The curated dataset is publicly accessible to support advances in cement and concrete research.

title: Role of antisite disorder in dictating the Ising anisotropy and ferromagnetic ground state of NdGaSi
title_zh: 反位无序在决定 NdGaSi 伊辛各向异性和铁磁基态中的作用
summary: 单离子各向异性和交换相互作用共同设定了稀土金属间化合物的磁性基态，但化学无序对配体亚晶格的作用仍然很少被探索。在这里，我们发现 NdGaSi 中的 Ga/Si 反位无序稳定了中心对称的 I4₁/amd 结构，并将 Nd3⁺ 位点对称性提高到 D2d，这禁止晶体电场（CEF）哈密顿量中的所有 m=±2 史蒂文斯算符。磁化强度、比热、单晶中子衍射和 X 射线吸收光谱建立了无序结构和低于 T_Capprox11~K 的共线铁磁序，并具有沿 c 的伊辛各向异性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27334v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Single-ion anisotropy and exchange interactions together set the magnetic ground state of rare-earth intermetallics, yet the role of chemical disorder on the ligand sublattice remains little explored. Here, we show that Ga/Si antisite disorder in NdGaSi stabilises the centrosymmetric I4₁/amd structure and raises the Nd³⁺ site symmetry to D₂d, which forbids all m=±2 Stevens operators in the crystalline electric field (CEF) Hamiltonian. Magnetization, specific heat, single-crystal neutron diffraction, and x-ray absorption spectroscopy establish the disordered structure and a collinear ferromagnetic order below T_Capprox11~K with Ising anisotropy along c. A CEF analysis that fits the susceptibilities along both axes and the magnetic specific heat simultaneously yields a ground-state doublet that is sim97% pure, in contrast to the strongly mixed ground state of the Al/Si-ordered NdAlSi (C₂ᵥ site symmetry of Nd³⁺). We argue that this ground-state purity makes the ordered moment rigid against the modulation due to frustrated exchange, selecting a k=0 ferromagnet in NdGaSi instead of the incommensurate ferrimagnet of NdAlSi. Antisite disorder, thus, acts as a handle on CEF ground-state purity and can, thereby, select between fundamentally different magnetic ground states.

title: Chiral Spinterfaces as an Overlooked Component of the Chiral-Induced Spin Selectivity Effect
title_zh: 手性旋转面作为手性诱导自旋选择性效应中被忽视的组成部分
summary: 手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应通常与通过手性分子的自旋选择性传输有关，而分子-电极界面的作用仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们证明手性氨基酸衍生分子在具有天然 NiO 层的铁磁镍薄膜上的吸附会诱导剩余的手性依赖性磁光响应。系统控制实验表明，这种响应源自分子-NiO/Ni 界面，而不是分子层或块状铁磁体。第一原理计算揭示了优先的羧酸盐结合和界面电荷重新分布延伸到 NiO 表面层，展示了分子吸附如何改变氧化物的电子结构。
abstract: arXiv:2608.17608v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The chiral-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect is commonly associated with spin-selective transport through chiral molecules, while the role of molecule-electrode interfaces remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that adsorption of chiral amino acid derived molecules on ferromagnetic Ni films with native NiO layer induces a remanent chirality-dependent magneto-optical response. Systematic control experiments establish that this response originates from the molecule-NiO/Ni interface, rather than the molecular layer or bulk ferromagnet. First-principles calculations reveal preferential carboxylate binding and interfacial charge redistribution extending into the NiO surface layers, demonstrating how molecular adsorption modifies the electronic structure of the oxide. Together, these results provide evidence for the formation of chiral spinterfaces, where molecular chirality and interfacial electronic structure give rise to a distinct magnetic response. Our findings highlight the previously overlooked role of molecule-electrode interfaces in CISS-related systems and identify interfacial electronic and magnetic properties as important considerations for understanding and controlling spin selectivity.

title: Lattice-geometry dependence of Type-I and Type-II magnetic flux responses in strongly correlated bosons
title_zh: 强相关玻色子中 I 型和 II 型磁通量响应的晶格几何依赖性
summary: 超流体和超导体根据其对磁通量的响应分为 I 型和 II 型，但这种分类几乎没有针对磁通量下的晶格玻色子，其中迈斯纳相和涡旋相主要在梯形几何中进行研究。在这里，我们通过使用密度矩阵重整化群，研究了带有最近邻相互作用 V 的扩展 Bose-Hubbard 模型在具有两到四条腿的方形和三角形梯子半填充时的通量响应。在方梯上，涡旋相位被限制在 V=0 附近的区域。在有限 V 处，磁通感应电荷密度波 (CDW) 阶取代了它，并且响应变得类似 I 型。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27749v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superfluids and superconductors are classified into Type-I and Type-II according to their response to a magnetic flux, but this classification has hardly been addressed for lattice bosons under magnetic flux, where the Meissner and vortex phases have been studied mostly in ladder geometries. Here, we study the flux response of the extended Bose-Hubbard model with nearest-neighbor interaction V at half filling on square and triangular ladders with two to four legs by using the density-matrix renormalization group. On the square ladders, the vortex phase is confined to a region near V=0. At finite V, a magnetic flux-induced charge-density-wave (CDW) order replaces it, and the response becomes Type-I-like. In contrast, on the triangular ladders, the vortex phase persists over the whole range of V studied, and the response remains Type-II-like. By extrapolating the ladder results to two dimensions, we argue that the Type-I or Type-II character of the flux response depends on the lattice geometry, which suggests a role of geometric frustration.

title: Nonmonotonic Magnetic Correlations in Decorated Lieb-Lattice Anderson Models
title_zh: 装饰利布格子安德森模型中的非单调磁相关性
summary: 电子关联和晶格几何之间的相互作用可以强烈改变多轨道哈密顿量中磁关联和局部单线态形成之间的竞争。在这里，我们使用行列式量子蒙特卡罗模拟来研究两个周期性类安德森模型，这些模型是通过选择性地将局域轨道与利布晶格的不等位点杂交而构建的。由此产生的几何形状具有部分填充的平带和不同的亚晶格不平衡性。我们研究了随着杂化程度的增加，局部自旋相关性和轨道分辨磁结构因素的演变。尽管杂化轨道之间的相关性相对平稳地朝着局部单线态形成发展，但较长程的磁相关性表现出对杂化的惊人的非单调依赖性。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27247v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay between electronic correlations and lattice geometry can strongly modify the competition between magnetic correlations and local singlet formation in multiorbital Hamiltonians. Here we use determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations to investigate two periodic Anderson-like models constructed by selectively hybridizing localized orbitals to the inequivalent sites of a Lieb lattice. The resulting geometries possess partially filled flat bands and different sublattice imbalances. We examine the evolution of local spin correlations and orbital-resolved magnetic structure factors as the hybridization is increased. Although correlations between hybridized orbitals evolve relatively smoothly toward local singlet formation, the longer-range magnetic correlations exhibit a striking nonmonotonic dependence on hybridization. In particular, we observe a pronounced suppression at intermediate hybridization followed by a substantial recovery on undecorated lattice sites. We discuss these results in relation to earlier studies of depleted periodic Anderson models and the constraints imposed by Lieb's theorem. Our findings illustrate how selective hybridization and flat-band structure can produce unusual redistributions of magnetic correlations in strongly interacting multiorbital systems.

title: Topological phases protected by half-chiral symmetry
title_zh: 受半手性对称性保护的拓扑相
summary: 手性（或子晶格）对称性描述了二分系统，例如 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 链，其中禁止同子晶格 A-A 和 B-B 跳跃，从而能够保护拓扑相。在这里，我们确定了受半手性对称性保护的新拓扑相，其中手性对称性仅保留在一个亚晶格上，这可能发生在亚晶格不平衡（例如石墨烯-六方氮化硼）或局域轨道（例如闪锌矿）中。与群论描述的传统对称算子不同，半手性对称是亚晶格投影哈密顿量的代数约束，例如 PHP=0，需要新的拓扑保护框架。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26693v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chiral (or sublattice) symmetry describes bipartite systems such as the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) chain where same-sublattice A-A and B-B hoppings are forbidden, enabling the protection of topological phases. Here we identify new topological phases protected by half-chiral symmetry wherein chiral symmetry is preserved on only one sublattice, as may occur with sublattice imbalance (e.g. graphene-hBN) or localized orbitals (e.g. zincblende). Unlike conventional symmetry operators described by group theory, half-chiral symmetry is an algebraic constraint on the sublattice-projected Hamiltonian such as PHP=0, requiring a new framework for topological protection. We develop such a framework, identifying real-space bulk topological invariants and corresponding topological boundary modes that stick to zero energy. In two dimensions we construct a half-chiral Kekule honeycomb model and show that its unusual higher-order topology protects a single zero-energy mode at a single corner.

title: Transition-Metal Substitutions in MOF-5: A Hybrid-DFT Study of Oxygen Electrocatalysis
title_zh: MOF-5 中的过渡金属取代：氧电催化的混合 DFT 研究
summary: 采用混合密度泛函理论计算研究了 MOF-5 金属有机骨架 [Zn(₄)O(BDC)(₃), BDC = 1,4-苯二甲酸] 中取代 Zn 位点 (M(ᵣₘ Zₙ)) 的过渡金属杂质的稳定性、电子性质和催化活性，其中 M = Sc、Ti、V、Cr、Mn、Fe、Co、Ni 和 Cu。大多数取代在 MOF-5 带隙内引入 (3d) 态并诱导局部磁矩。部分占据（3d）态促进轨道杂化和含氧中间体的电荷转移，激活掺杂位点以实现氧电催化。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid density functional theory calculations were used to investigate the stability, electronic properties, and catalytic activity of transition-metal impurities substituting Zn sites (M(ᵣₘ Zₙ)) in the MOF-5 metal-organic framework [Zn(₄)O(BDC)(₃), BDC = 1,4-benzenedicarboxylate], with M = Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, and Cu. Most substitutions introduce (3d) states within the MOF-5 band gap and induce localized magnetic moments. Partially occupied (3d) states promote orbital hybridization and charge transfer with oxygenated intermediates, activating the dopant sites toward oxygen electrocatalysis. The oxygen reduction and evolution reaction (ORR and OER) activities were evaluated using the computational hydrogen electrode model. Mn(ᵣₘ Zₙ) and Fe(ᵣₘ Zₙ) exhibit calculated ORR overpotentials of 0.57~V, while Mn(ᵣₘ Zₙ) and Co(ᵣₘ Zₙ) yield OER overpotentials of 0.42 and 0.51~V, respectively, approaching those of benchmark precious-metal electrocatalysts. These findings identify Mn substitution as a promising strategy for achieving bifunctional ORR/OER activity in MOF-5 and establish a link between dopant electronic structure and catalytic performance to guide the design of MOF-based electrocatalysts.

title: When the magnetic force theorem fails: dressed exchange in the induced-moment magnets FePt, FePd, CoPt, and CoPd
title_zh: 当磁力定理失效时：感应力矩磁体 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 中的交换
summary: 流动磁体的有效自旋哈密顿量通常由磁力定理 (MFT) 交换常数参数化，随后用于计算复杂而微妙的自旋纹理（例如斯格明子）的行为。我们表明，对于含有自旋敏感性较大的原子（例如 Pd 或 Pt）的系统，这种方法忽略了能量学的重要部分。对于 FePt，它甚至预测了错误的基态。对完全自洽的自旋螺旋密度泛函计算进行基准测试（其中电子结构，包括诱导的 Pd/Pt 矩，对于每种自旋配置都是松弛的），我们量化了有序 L1₀ 合金 FePt、FePd、CoPt 和 CoPd 缺失的能量。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26697v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Effective spin Hamiltonians for itinerant magnets are commonly parameterized by magnetic-force-theorem (MFT) exchange constants, which are subsequently used to compute the behavior of complex and delicate spin textures, for example skyrmions. We show that for systems containing atoms with large spin susceptibility, such as Pd or Pt, this approach misses important parts of the energetics. For FePt, it even predicts the wrong ground state. Benchmarking against fully self-consistent spin-spiral density-functional calculations - in which the electronic structure, including the induced Pd/Pt moments, relaxes for every spin configuration - we quantify the missing energetics for the ordered L1₀ alloys FePt, FePd, CoPt, and CoPd. By comparing a family of models that differ only in their treatment of the induced Pt moment, including the configuration-dependent models of Mryasov and Polesya, we identify the origin: the energetics of the induced moments are governed by the exchange-enhanced (dressed) susceptibility, of which the frozen-potential MFT captures only the bare part - about one third of the Pt-mediated interaction in FePt. We derive a general bound showing that no on-site (intra-atomic) refinement can supply the missing strength. The dressing decides the magnetic ground state in FePt, where the interlayer ordering rests entirely on the Pt-mediated interactions, and shifts the Curie temperatures of the other alloys by several hundred kelvin. Computed ordering temperatures, magnon spectra and spin wave stiffness for all four compounds are provided.

title: Tailoring Phonon Transport in Bi-based Quaternary Half-Heusler alloys for Thermoelectric Applications
title_zh: 用于热电应用的双基四元半霍斯勒合金中的声子传输定制
summary: 四元half-Heusler (QHH) 是传统halfHeusler (HH) 化合物的替代无序衍生物，它提供了改变声子输运和增强热电性能的潜在途径。在这里，我们使用第一性原理计算和非谐晶格动力学研究了四元半 Heuslers ZrHfRh2Bi2、ZrHfIr2Bi2、Zr2RhIrBi2 和 Hf2RhIrBi2 的热电性质。四种化合物中，ZrHfRh2Bi2和Zr2RhIrBi2表现出半导体电子结构，其他化合物本质上是半金属。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quaternary half-Heuslers (QHHs) are substitutionally disordered derivatives of conventional halfHeusler (HH) compounds, which offer a potential route to modify phonon transport and enhance thermoelectric performance. Here, we investigate the thermoelectric properties of the quaternary half-Heuslers ZrHfRh2Bi2, ZrHfIr2Bi2, Zr2RhIrBi2, and Hf2RhIrBi2 using first-principles calculations and anharmonic lattice dynamics. Among four compounds, ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2 exhibit semiconducting electronic structure and others are semimetallic in nature. Both the semiconducting compounds show favorable electronic transport properties. However, quaternary substitution substantially modifies the phonon dispersion, lowering the average phonon group velocity by about 17-22% relative to the parent compounds while leaving the anharmonic scattering rates comparable. The combination of high power factor and low kl results in high thermoelectric performance, with maximum ZT values of 2.28 and 2.18 at 1000 K for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2, respectively, with maximum thermoelectric power conversion efficiency 16.3% for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2. Further reducing the grain size enhances the thermoelectric performance, with maximum ZT values of 2.51 and 2.58 at 1000 K for p-type ZrHfRh2Bi2 and Zr2RhIrBi2, respectively, at a grain size of 30 nm. Our results demonstrate that combining substitutional disorder with grain boundary engineering, provides an effective strategy to enhance the thermoelectric performance of HH compounds.

title: Artificial Spin-Glass of Antiferromagnetic Co3O4 Nanocubes Using Spin-Polarized Oxygen
title_zh: 使用自旋极化氧的反铁磁 Co3O4 纳米立方体的人工自旋玻璃
summary: 使用立方体形状的纳米粒子优先暴露 Co3O4 的 (100) 表面终端，产生非常规的离子重排，从而从反铁磁性纳米立方体产生旋转玻璃状的磁性。必要的磁挫败是由于 O 2p 和 Co 3d 轨道之间的电荷转移引起的极化 Co-O 键之间的竞争以及高度各向异性的 Co²⁺ 离子与八面体位点中异常高自旋 Co³⁺ 离子的结合而产生的。尺寸控制允许通过优先极化的 Co-O 键来调节这种新颖的离子组合。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26860v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Preferentially exposing (100) surface terminations of Co₃O₄ using cube-shaped nanoparticles yields an unconventional rearrangement of ions that generates spin-glass-like magnetism from the antiferromagnetic nanocubes. The necessary magnetic frustration arises out of competition between polarized Co-O bonds from charge transfer between O 2p and Co 3d orbitals, and highly anisotropic Co²⁺ ions combined with anomalous high spin Co³⁺ ions in octahedral sites. Size control permits tuning this novel combination of ions via preferentially polarizing Co-O bonds. The presence of control over frustrated magnetism among antiferromagnetic nanocubes yields an artificial spin glass platform for exploring unconventional nanomagnetism and engendering new opportunities for emerging technologies like spintronics and physical reservoir computing.

title: Deconfined criticality between an antiferromagnetic insulator and a nodal d-wave superconductor: a quantum Monte Carlo study
title_zh: 反铁磁绝缘体和节点 d 波超导体之间的解除临界临界性：量子蒙特卡罗研究
summary: 我们提出了量子蒙特卡罗研究，研究半填充时方形晶格上的绝缘尼尔态和节点 d 波超导体之间的转变。我们使用电子的费米子自旋子和玻色子电荷的部分子表示来访问受挫磁序状态，而不会出现符号问题。两个部分子都在背景 π 通量中移动（因此电子没有经历净通量），并耦合到量子涨落 SU(2) 晶格规范场。与早期直接对电子自由度的研究相比，我们发现了二阶解禁量子相变的证据，在该相变中，尼尔和 d 波超导阶连续消失。
abstract: arXiv:2607.00762v5 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a quantum Monte Carlo study of the transition between the insulating Néel state and the nodal d-wave superconductor on the square lattice at half-filling. We access a regime of frustrated magnetic order without a sign problem using a parton representation of the electron in terms of fermionic spinons and bosonic chargons. Both partons move in a background π-flux (so the electron experiences no net flux) and are coupled to a quantum fluctuating SU(2) lattice gauge field. In contrast to earlier studies directly on the electronic degrees of freedom, we find evidence for a second-order deconfined quantum phase transition at which both the Néel and d-wave superconductivity orders vanish continuously. We compute correlators of the spinon-chargon composite with the same quantum numbers as the electron: we find a gapless Dirac dispersion inside the d-wave superconductor, turning into a gapped dispersion in the antiferromagnet.

title: Frustration-Stabilized Hexamerons and Their Topological Magnons in Janus MXene
title_zh: Janus MXene 中的挫败稳定六聚体及其拓扑磁振子
summary: 三角形晶格上的受挫磁体有利于非共线顺序，当反演对称性被打破时，它们可以在该顺序之上承载局部拓扑纹理。在这里，我们展示了 Janus MXene MnHf2C2FI 就是这样一个系统。将第一性原理计算与原子自旋模拟相结合，我们发现磁性仅限于 Mn 层，其中强烈的反铁磁最近邻交换以及相当大的 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用稳定了受抑的 120 Neel 基态。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frustrated magnets on triangular lattices favour noncollinear order, and when inversion symmetry is broken they can host localized topological textures on top of that order. Here we show that the Janus MXene MnHf2C2FI is such a system. Combining first-principles calculations with atomistic spin simulations, we find that magnetism is confined to the Mn layer, where a strong antiferromagnetic nearest-neighbor exchange together with a sizable Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction stabilizes a frustrated 120 Neel ground state. On top of this ground state we identify a metastable hexameron: a composite of six merons and antimerons, one vortex-antivortex pair on each of the three sublattices, whose sublattice-resolved topological charges compensate. Linear spin-wave theory confirms that the hexameron is a local energy minimum, and its noncoplanar cores act as potential wells that bind discrete in-gap magnon modes below the bulk continuum. In a periodic hexameron array the magnon bands carry nonzero Chern numbers, and the resulting Berry curvature produces a magnon thermal Hall response whose sign depends on which of the two time-reversal partners of the hexameron is realized. Our results establish Janus MXenes as a two-dimensional platform in which frustration, broken inversion symmetry, and spin-orbit coupling combine to produce metastable antiferromagnetic solitons with distinct spectroscopic and transport fingerprints.

title: Growth and anisotropic directional dependent transport properties of Altermagnetic CrSb
title_zh: 交变磁 CrSb 的生长和各向异性方向依赖输运特性
summary: CrSb 是一种金属交变磁体，在远高于室温的温度下表现出较大的动量相关自旋分裂和反铁磁有序性。尽管其电子和磁输运特性引起了相当大的关注，但对使用不同生长方法制备的晶体的系统比较仍然有限。在这里，我们研究了通过 Sb(自)-通量、Bi 通量和化学气相传输 (CVT) 生长的 CrSb 单晶的结构、磁性和各向异性传输特性。每一种生长都显示出不同的晶体形态。磁化测量表现出广泛一致的反铁磁响应，并在双助熔剂生长的晶体中观察到了额外的低温贡献。
abstract: arXiv:2611.27072v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: CrSb is a metallic altermagnet exhibiting large momentum-dependent spin splitting and antifer- romagnetic ordering well above room temperature. Although its electronic and magnetotransport properties have attracted considerable attention, a systematic comparison of crystals prepared us- ing different growth methods remains limited. Here we investigate the structural, magnetic, and anisotropic transport properties of CrSb single crystals grown by Sb(self)-flux, Bi flux, and chem- ical vapor transport (CVT). Each of these growth reveals distinct crystal morphologies. Magne- tization measurements exhibit broadly consistent antiferromagnetic responses, with an additional low-temperature contribution observed in Bi-flux-grown crystals. All samples display metallic resis- tivity and positive, nonsaturating magnetoresistance up to 9 T. Sb-flux- and CVT-grown crystals exhibit comparable residual resistivity ratios and magnetoresistance, whereas Bi-flux-grown crys- tals show enhanced residual resistivity and a substantially reduced magnetoresistance, consistent with stronger carrier scattering. Hall measurements reveal a pronounced dependence on the field- current configuration, including nonlinear field dependence and opposite Hall polarities for different crystallographic orientations. These results establish the reproducibility of anisotropic magneto- transport across distinct growth routes while highlighting the sensitivity of carrier scattering to crystal-growth conditions. Our findings provide a comparative framework for selecting CrSb single crystals for orientation-dependent transport and spintronic investigations.

title: Impact of spin fluctuations on spectral functions and transport in a model altermagnet
title_zh: 自旋涨落对模型交流磁体中光谱函数和输运的影响
summary: 了解交流磁体中的自旋相关输运对于将其纳入下一代自旋电子技术非常重要。受强相关量子材料中交变磁性发现的启发，我们使用费米子蒙特卡罗方法在棋盘格哈伯德模型中探索这种物理现象，该方法跟踪自旋波动作为温度函数的完整空间依赖性。我们提出了当我们从有序基态进入高温无序顺磁相时，自旋相关的单粒子光谱函数和输运演化的结果。我们的结果可以在未来的自旋选择角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和在固态量子材料或拟议的超冷原子系统中实现的候选交替磁体的自旋输运实验中进行测试。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26725v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding spin dependent transport in altermagnets is important for incorporating them in next generation spintronic technologies. Motivated by the discovery of altermagnetism in strongly correlated quantum materials, we explore this physics in the checkerboard lattice Hubbard model using a fermion Monte Carlo approach which tracks the full spatial dependence of spin fluctuations as a function of temperature. We present results for the evolution of the spin-dependent single particle spectral functions and transport as we go from the ordered ground state into the high temperature disordered paramagnetic phase. Our results could be tested in future spin-selective angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) and spin transport experiments in candidate altermagnets realized in solid state quantum materials or in proposed ultracold atomic systems.

title: Local moment magnon spectrum in conduction electron tunnelling
title_zh: 传导电子隧道中的局域矩磁振子谱
summary: 研究了由具有反铁磁序的局域矩通过现场交换相互作用耦合到传导电子的双系统的表面隧道谱。在局部矩阶的静态近似中，已知磁带重建会导致局部矩的磁阶向量处的异常隧道谱，尽管后者不能直接贡献。在这项工作中，我们通过考虑来自局部矩磁振子激发的传导电子的散射来考虑动态效应。它们导致自能和传导态的重整化，这反过来又显着地改变了隧道谱，使其超出了静态顺序的影响，解释为磁振子边带的出现。
abstract: arXiv:2607.05858v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The surface tunnelling spectrum of a dual system consisting of localised moments with antiferromagnetic order coupled to conduction electrons by on-site exchange interaction is investigated. In the static approximation of the local moment order it is known that magnetic band reconstruction leads to an anomalous tunnelling spectrum at the magnetic ordering vector of local moments although the latter cannot contribute directly. In this work we consider dynamic effects by including the scattering of conduction electrons from the local moment magnon excitations. They lead to self energies and renormalisation of conduction states which in turn appreciably modify the tunnelling spectrum beyond the influence of static order, interpreted as the appearance of magnon sidebands.
